# Channels that need not exist on both phones, checked by scripts/check-channels.sh.
# One entry per line: `<channel>  # <reason>`. Lines starting with # are comments. The guard fails
# on a line with no reason or one not listed here.
#
# Reasons:
#   ios-impossible  iOS has no API for it (notification capture).
#   ios-part-two    iOS gets it in a later part of the iOS plan (voice).
#   android-only    debug test hooks that exist on Android only.
wambito/capture  # ios-impossible
wambito/voice  # ios-part-two
wambito/voice/events  # ios-part-two
wambito/test  # android-only
